data.headline: Dow futures asset-manager net longs fall
data.summary: From October 27 to November 3, the asset-manager net long in Dow futures fell by 4,013 contracts. Leveraged funds increased their smaller net long while total open interest declined.

bull.text: The leveraged-fund net long rose from 96 to 820 contracts in the November 3 report.

bear.text: The asset-manager net long fell from 12,233 to 8,220 contracts and total open interest fell from 91,636 to 87,410.

watch.text: Between November 5 and 6 the thirty-year Treasury yield rose to 5.26% from 5.25% and the ten-year rose to 4.86% from 4.84%. Long-term project financing also depends on each issuer’s credit spread.

limitations: The Treasury yields are dated November 6. This report has no verified ETF closing-price or return observation.
The CFTC observations are weekly futures positions as of November 3. ETF flows and investor intent require separate evidence.
